extraction.teacher_style: The instructor guides a group of students sitting in a circle in an outdoor courtyard while practicing traditional rhythmic chants and hand movements. The teaching style is informal and collaborative, with students laughing, correcting each other, and coordinating timing together.

lesson_structure.note: Students sit in a circle outdoors in school uniforms, practicing rhythmic hand claps and vocalizations.
Group practices chanting and synchronized hand gestures in a circle.
Group continues practicing vocal chants with rhythmic clapping.
Students continue group vocal and hand practice, occasionally breaking into laughter and restarting.

steps_taught.name: Didong rhythmic clapping and chanting
steps_taught.description: Seated rhythmic vocalization and synchronized hand claps in a circle.

what_works: Sitting in a circle allows all participants to see and hear each other clearly.
what_hinders: Background noise and student chatter make it difficult to hear specific instructions.

evidence_segments.observation: Students sitting in a circle clapping hands rhythmically together.
Participants extending hands forward and clapping in rhythm while chanting.

extraction.distinctive_method: Group circle practice where participants sit on the ground outdoors, combining vocal chants and hand percussion without a raised instructor.
